source: Hand-driven through the real WS131 client (app/connectors/puco/puco.py's _consultar_ws131) against an in-process fake upstream — sisa.msal.gov.ar is not reachable/credentialed from this environment. Response XML shape matches puco.py's own module docstring (the documented WS131 example payload). Produced by running the real client through this cassette engine's own recorder (tests/cassettes/_vcr.py, TURNOS_CASSETTE_MODE=record), then PII-scrubbed the same way a live recording would be — though the DNI/name fed in are this repo's own well-known synthetic test fixtures (99887766, 'Prueba Renaper'), never a real citizen. Re-record against the real WS131 endpoint (scripts/record_cassette.py --connector puco --scenario consulta_ok) once SISA service-account credentials exist, and diff-review before committing, per Area 3's doctrine.
